Review Date: Reviewed in the United States on January 13, 2025
Review Body:
I have to say I skimmed some sections. I found some points to be a little belabored, but at least the message was clear and well-supported with logic.

I did wish the citations were easier to follow. In the Kindle version, you can click on a superscript to see the source, but it only gives author and date, no title. I don't want to have to track down the bibliography while reading.

Also, this is completely unrelated to the subject matter, but the author's anecdote about how his adolescent puppy learned to be okay with larger dog by letting her running up to leashed stranger dogs is a horrible way to socialize your dog! Many ordinarily social dogs will become defensive and reactive when approached by an overexcited loose dog when they tethered by a leash and can't move away. I lost respect for the author when I read that section, complete with a photo of his dog running erratically around a tense and leashed GSD.
